title: Transit shelter campaign pair
slide_intent: Compare alternative images in a repeated placement because a campaign needs variation without losing its reading structure.
strategic_value: Consistent copy and signature placement can connect Dropbox’s abstract and photographic executions.
demonstration: Two transit-shelter photographs contrast a pink abstract image with a burgundy photographic collage advertisement.
practical_value: Identify which layout relationships stay fixed when image content changes.

content_islands.name: Left shelter
content_islands.spec: Retain the abstract image above its copy in the pink advertisement.

content_islands.name: Right shelter
content_islands.spec: Keep the burgundy ground, upper copy and lower photographic composition within the shelter.
